company_page.meta_about_title: Energy Plus LLC. Full-Cycle Engineering Company. Gas Pipeline Design. Boiler Construction.
company_page.meta_about_description: Engineering company Energy Plus. Comprehensive turnkey engineering for industrial facilities. Gasification, industrial gas boiler houses, equipment supply.
company_page.meta_about_h1: Energy Plus LLC. Industrial gasification, heat and power engineering, gas metering, modular boiler rooms, turnkey construction.
company_page.about_p1: LLC Energy Plus is an engineering company delivering comprehensive design and construction of utility and energy infrastructure. Primarily, these include gas, heat, and power supply systems for commercial and industrial facilities, including boiler rooms and mini-CHP plants.
company_page.about_p2: Our core expertise in industrial safety enables us to deliver engineering services conforming to the highest standards of energy efficiency, reliability, automation, and environmental protection. Over two decades of industry experience allows us to devise optimal engineering solutions, optimize capital expenditures, anticipate risks, and guarantee on-time project completion.
company_page.about_p3: To achieve these standards, we actively apply EPC contracting as a unified project management model across all lifecycle stages. Integrated management of engineering and construction significantly reduces delivery schedules and completely eliminates unexpected cost overruns for the Client. A comprehensive breakdown of our technical client services is available here.
company_page.about_p4: Our multidisciplinary team unites certified surveyors, design engineers, technicians, installers, and project managers who hold all necessary regulatory clearances and licenses to work on hazardous industrial facilities.
company_page.meta_history_title: Company History. Energy Plus. Full-Cycle Engineering
company_page.meta_history_description: Energy Plus — engineering company. Design documentation, installation, pipelines, industrial gas boilers, modular boiler fabrication.
company_page.meta_history_h1: Full-cycle engineering, EPC contracts, boiler room design and installation in Moscow & across Russia. Factory-made block-modular boiler plants.
company_page.history_p1: LLC Energy Plus was founded in 2003.
company_page.history_p2: Since its establishment, the company has grown dynamically and operated successfully in the Russian engineering market. Over the years, we have accumulated unique experience across fuel and energy sector projects, building a high-caliber team of managers, engineers, and certified craftsmen.
company_page.history_p3: We have completed over 100 complex turnkey engineering projects and commissioned dozens of utility and industrial energy facilities. Our corporate partners include Transstroy Corporation, Soyuzdorproekt, Rosmix, Mosgaz, Mosoblgaz, and many others.
company_page.history_p4: Our clients highlight the stability, reliability, and superior quality of cooperation with Energy Plus, achieved through our comprehensive project approach, rigorous quality standards, and adoption of cutting-edge engineering technologies.
